captions.linkedin:
Two-column resume templates are popular because they look great. The catch: many applicant tracking systems read a page straight across, line by line, so text from both columns gets interleaved into something like "Data Analyst at SQL, Python".

That's why every QuickFit CV template is one column, real selectable text and standard headings. You can check any resume with our free ATS checker, which shows the text an ATS actually gets.

https://quickfitcv.com
